subject: MAP: POC environment kickoff — org setup, API keys, IP allowlist & VPC peering timeline
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimbushealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ava Rodriguez <ava.rodriguez@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2028-04-22 09:12 PDT
Subject: MAP kickoff: POC environment requirements and proposed timeline

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and the cost profile you showed. We want to lock the Mutual Action Plan so our evaluation (two-week POC) can start the week of May 8. To hit that date we need to align on a few items that will be in the MAP: org setup, staging API keys, IP allowlist, and VPC peering.

High-level asks from our side:
- A staged API key for our sandbox org (least privilege)
- Redwood org invite for the evaluation team (Ava and two engineers)
- IP allowlist entries for your ingress (we will provide CIDRs)
- VPC peering guide and initial peering window (we can schedule a 1-hour network call)

I attached our filled security questionnaire (redacted where appropriate). Can you confirm owners and a checklist we can track in the MAP? Also: do you require an MOA or simple network authorization?

Appreciate a short checklist + dates so we can circulate internally.

Best,
Samir
Samir Patel
Director, Platform Engineering
Nimbus Health

Attachments: Nimbus_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ava Rodriguez <ava.rodriguez@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2028-04-22 11:05 PDT
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: POC environment requirements and proposed timeline

Samir — thanks, this is straightforward. I put together an initial MAP checklist below with owners and target dates so we can make the May 8/May 22 cadence you suggested (May 8 POC start, validation sprint through May 22). See also the attached Redwood VPC peering instructions.

Redwood — Nimbus MAP (high level)
- Redwood creates sandbox org + staging API key (Priyom) — target 2028-04-24
- Nimbus provides IP ranges + VPC CIDR + peering contact (Samir) — target 2028-04-24
- Network sync (1-hr) to confirm routes, security groups, and NAT behavior (Connor leading) — proposed 2028-04-25 10:00 PT
- Temporary allowlist for staging endpoints (manual) + apply caching policies (Marissa) — target 2028-04-26
- Formal MOA / network authorization (legal) if requested (both teams) — target for signature 2028-05-02
- Go-live (POC start) — 2028-05-08

A few implementation notes:
1) Staging API keys: we will issue a scoped API key with rate limits and token expiry. It will be created in your org and can be rotated on request.
2) Org invites: please confirm the two engineer emails (Ava, cc'd) and one admin to receive invite; we will provision RBAC roles to limit token creation to admins.
3) VPC peering: our instructions include both direct peering and Transit options depending on your cloud layout. See redwood_vpc_peering_instructions.pdf attached.
4) IP allowlist: we prefer CIDR blocks for egress so we can minimize firewall churn. If you only have single IPs we can accept those too but recommend CIDR where possible.

Next steps: I will create the MAP in HubSpot and add these actions/owners. Connor, can you confirm 04/25 10:00 PT for the network sync?

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Strategic Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_vpc_peering_instructions.pdf
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimbushealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ava Rodriguez <ava.rodriguez@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2028-04-24 08:30 PDT
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: POC environment requirements and proposed timeline

On Apr 22, 2028, Priyom wrote:
> A few implementation notes:
> 1) Staging API keys: we will issue a scoped API key with rate limits and token expiry.

Samir / Ava — quick notes from the networking side ahead of the call:
- Please provide the VPC CIDR you plan to peer (primary and secondary if using multi-az) and the preferred peering window (we have a maintenance window 02:00–06:00 PT for disruptive route updates, but most peering is non-disruptive).
- For IP allowlist, send the full list in CIDR format ideally; if you provide single IPs we will translate them to /32 entries.
- NAT and egress: confirm whether you send traffic through a NAT gateway or direct egress — this affects advertised prefixes for peering.
- For the staging API key we can provide two options: (A) time-limited key embedded in your sandbox org, or (B) proxy-access with short-lived tokens (OAuth). Option A is fastest for POC.

Network preflight checklist (I will own these items):
- Confirm CIDRs and peering contacts (Samir) — due 2028-04-24
- Validate route tables and update security groups (Connor) — due 2028-04-25 after the sync
- Confirm TLS/ALPN negotiation and IP allowlist reachability from Nimbus (Connor) — due 2028-04-26

If we get the CIDR + peering contact today I will circulate a calendar invite for 04/25 10:00 PT and share a short runbook for the call.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Network Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimbushealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ava Rodriguez <ava.rodriguez@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2028-04-25 17:45 PDT
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: POC environment requirements and proposed timeline

Thanks — appreciate the clarity. Attached is our network ranges spreadsheet (nimbus_network_ranges.xlsx) with primary/secondary CIDRs and contact for our cloud network lead (cloudops@nimbushealth.com).

Quick answers:
- CIDRs attached.
- We normally egress through a NAT gateway (so peering will need the prefixes NAT advertises).
- We prefer option A for the POC (time-limited scoped API key).
- We are happy to sign an MOA if that helps; I've attached a draft MOA (MOA_draft_for_signature.pdf).

Two quick security questions for your team:
1) Will the staging key support enforced MFA for the admin console?
2) Do you support customer-managed KMS for log encryption in private deployments (we understand hosted will use Redwood-managed KMS but want to know options for Private later)?

We can make the 04/25 10:00 PT call — Samir's ops lead will join for network-level items. If everything looks good we'll aim to sign MOA by 05/02 and start the POC on 05/08.

Regards,
Samir

Attachments: nimbus_network_ranges.xlsx, MOA_draft_for_signature.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ava Rodriguez <ava.rodriguez@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2028-04-25 20:15 PDT
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: POC environment requirements and proposed timeline

Samir — thanks for the ranges and MOA draft. Quick replies to your security questions and next actions: 

1) MFA: yes — we enforce MFA for console/admin access. API keys themselves are bearer tokens; we will scope the staging key to only the generation/consumption endpoints required for the POC and set a 14-day expiry by default. Admin actions that can create/rotate keys require MFA.
2) KMS: for Redwood Private we support customer-managed KMS (via your cloud KMS/HSM). For the hosted evaluation we use Redwood-managed encryption keys; if you need a private deployment we can add that to the MAP for a future milestone.

Next actions (confirmed):
- Redwood to issue a time-limited staging API key and create the sandbox org (Priyom) — will complete by 2028-04-26 EOD.
- Network sync scheduled (Connor) — calendar invite sent for 2028-04-25 10:00 PT (confirmed).
- Sign MOA target 2028-05-02 (both teams legal).
- POC start 2028-05-08.

I'll update the HubSpot MAP with these targets and attach all artifacts. If anything slips we'll re-evaluate the start date, but everything looks green on our side. Looking forward to the network call.

Best,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Strategic Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_vpc_peering_instructions.pdf (already sent)
